/.title: RevLens: look inside any binary, bundle or package
/.description: Zero-install reverse engineering triage in your browser, terminal or agent. Formats, SBOM, secrets, capabilities, rules and diffs. Files never leave your device.

/analyze.title: Analyze a file | RevLens
/analyze.description: Drop an ELF, PE, Mach-O, WASM, APK, extension, npm package or JavaScript bundle and get findings, SBOM, entropy, strings and a hex view, all in your browser.

/diff.title: Release diff | RevLens
/diff.description: Compare two builds of the same thing and see added, removed and changed dependencies, imports, endpoints, sections and findings.

/verify.title: Verify a claim | RevLens
/verify.description: Check a claim about a file against its actual bytes. Get VERIFIED, REFUTED or UNKNOWN with evidence you can check in seconds.

/docs.title: Docs | RevLens
/docs.description: How to use RevLens in the browser, from the CLI and as an MCP server for AI agents.

/blog.description: Notes on reverse engineering, supply chain triage and building tools for agents.
